Phone: Clerk's Office 978-521-7300Probation Department978-521-7300

The Somerset County Circuit Court is a crucial aspect of the legal system in Somerset County, Maryland. As a court of general jurisdiction, it handles a wide range of legal cases, including criminal, civil, juvenile, domestic relations, and probate cases. The purpose of the Somerset County Circuit Court is to provide a fair and impartial forum for the resolution of legal disputes in the county.

The Somerset County Circuit Court is located in the county seat of Princess Anne, Maryland. It serves the residents of Somerset County and is one of the busiest courts in the state.

History of Somerset County Circuit Court

The Somerset County Circuit Court was founded in the late 1700s, shortly after the county was established. Over the years, the court has evolved to meet the changing needs of the community. Today, it is a modern, technologically advanced court that is fully equipped to handle the legal needs of Somerset County residents.

Functions of Somerset County Circuit Court

The Somerset County Circuit Court handles a wide range of legal cases, including criminal, civil, juvenile, domestic relations, and probate cases. In criminal cases, the court hears serious offenses such as murder, assault, and theft. In civil cases, the court hears disputes between individuals or businesses, including contract disputes and personal injury cases. Juvenile cases involve minors who are accused of crimes or are in need of other legal services. Domestic relations cases include divorce, custody, and child support cases. Finally, probate cases involve the administration of estates and the distribution of assets to heirs.

Court Procedures

If you need to file a case in the Somerset County Circuit Court, you will need to follow certain procedures. First, you will need to complete the necessary forms and file them with the court. Next, you will need to schedule a hearing date and time. If you are representing yourself in court, you will need to prepare your case and be ready to present your arguments in front of the judge. If you are selected for jury duty, you will be expected to attend court and participate in the trial.

Trials in the Somerset County Circuit Court are conducted according to strict procedures and rules of evidence. The judge presides over the trial and makes decisions on legal issues, while a jury of your peers decides the facts of the case. If you are found guilty, the judge will sentence you according to the law. If you are unhappy with the outcome of your case, you may have the right to appeal.

Staff and Judges of Somerset County Circuit Court

The Somerset County Circuit Court is staffed by a team of dedicated professionals, including judges, clerks, bailiffs, and court reporters. The judges are responsible for making decisions on legal issues and presiding over trials. The clerks are responsible for maintaining court records and providing information to the public. The bailiffs are responsible for maintaining order in the courtroom. The court reporters are responsible for creating a record of the proceedings.

Services Provided by Somerset County Circuit Court

The Somerset County Circuit Court provides a variety of services to the public, including a self-help center, mediation services, payment of fines and fees, jury services, and access to records and documents. The self-help center provides information and assistance to individuals who are representing themselves in court. Mediation services are available to help resolve disputes outside of court. The court accepts payment of fines and fees in person or online. Jury services are available for individuals who are selected for jury duty. Finally, the court maintains records and documents that are available to the public.

Access to Information

The Somerset County Circuit Court provides access to information about cases and court proceedings. You can access case information online or in person at the court. The court also publishes court calendars that show the dates and times of upcoming hearings and trials. Finally, the court provides access to public records that are available to the public.

Community Outreach

The Somerset County Circuit Court is committed to serving the community and providing educational and volunteer opportunities. The court offers community education programs on a variety of legal topics. It also provides volunteer opportunities for individuals who are interested in serving their community. The court also offers internship programs for students who are interested in pursuing careers in the legal field.
